What we offer

Full-Scope Construction
& Civil Works

We handle every stage of a project — from the first shovel in the ground to the final coat of paint. One team, complete accountability.

01
Tendering & Quantity Surveying
Accurate bills of quantities, cost estimates, tender preparation and contract administration. Every figure verified, every submission competitive and compliant.
02
Site Clearance & Excavation
Full site preparation — vegetation clearing, bulk excavation, trenching, and earthworks. We prepare your ground so the rest of the build goes smoothly.
03
Substructure & Brickwork
Foundation laying, substructure construction, and full superstructure brickwork — delivered by our team of 5+ qualified builders under Class 1 supervision.
04
Roofing & Structural Works
Ring beams, columns, formwork, beam filling, and roof structure installation for both residential and commercial projects.
05
Electrical Works & Tubing
In-depth electrical installations, conduit tubing, and wiring for residential and commercial buildings — fully compliant with safety and regulatory standards.
06
Building Finishes
Plastering, screeding, tiling, painting, and all internal and external finishes. We leave every project complete, polished, and move-in ready.
07
Pavement & Civil Works
Interlocking paving, driveways, pathways, and civil groundworks for residential, commercial, and institutional sites across Zimbabwe.
08
Project Concepts & Feasibility
Preliminary concept documentation and feasibility assessments — equipping clients to engage architects and structural engineers with clarity and confidence.
09
Renovations & Refurbishment
Structural alterations, extensions, and full property refurbishments. We breathe new life into existing homes and commercial properties — on time and on budget.

Thinking of renovating your home or property?

Whether it's an extension, a full interior overhaul, or a structural alteration — Double Cast handles renovations of every scale. Our Class 1 builder and construction engineer assess your property, plan the work, and deliver to specification. Get in touch for a no-obligation assessment.

Who we are

Built on experience.
Driven by excellence.

Double Cast Construction & Civil Works is a Harare-based construction company offering the complete range of building and civil services — from tendering and site clearance right through to finishes, renovations, and pavement works.

Our team includes over 5 qualified builders led by a Class 1 builder with more than 15 years of industry experience, supported by a construction engineer and quantity surveyor, a specialist electrical technician, and a dedicated marketing professional.

From substructures in Tafara and Norton to commercial paving in Senton and Zimre — our footprint spans Harare and beyond, and continues to grow with every project we deliver.

01
Deep Experience
15+ years of hands-on construction expertise anchoring every project we deliver.
02
Complete Scope
From first excavation to final finish — one team, one contract, no gaps in accountability.
03
Transparency
Honest cost reporting, clear communication, and no surprises at every project stage.
04
Quality Workmanship
Certified builders and qualified engineers who take genuine pride in what they build.
